fichas.title: Private Sauna: Functions and Operating Conditions
fichas.summary: A private sauna can combine changing, relaxation, pre-cleaning, and cooling in one room, while some functions may instead be provided elsewhere in the house. The page describes sauna stove types, plunge pools, warm footbaths, room-temperature recommendations, and humidity at different sauna temperatures.

fichas.title: Sauna Cabin Types and Dimensions
fichas.summary: The sheet illustrates sauna cabins sized for different numbers of users, including built-in cabins and log-cabin constructions. Free-standing garden saunas are commonly spruce log cabins and may be self-built, prefabricated, or assembled from kit elements. Installation cabins usually use electric stoves; log-cabin types mostly use solid-fuel stoves.
